contentBlocks.text: ਅੱਜ ਅਸੀਂ ਅਨੁਵਾਦ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਾਂਗੇ। (Today we begin translation.) Real translation is never simple word-for-word substitution — it starts with understanding how word order itself differs between languages.

New words: ਵਾਕ (vaak, sentence), ਸ਼ਬਦ (shabad, word), ਕ੍ਰਮ (kram, order). English generally follows Subject-Verb-Object order: 'I drink water.' Punjabi generally follows Subject-Object-Verb order: ਮੈਂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਂਦਾ ਹਾਂ (literally 'I water drink'). If you translated word-for-word without reordering, you'd get an awkward or wrong sentence. Take the English sentence 'The girl reads a book' and identify its Subject-Verb-Object structure, then predict how the Punjabi word order (Subject-Object-Verb) would rearrange it before we translate it tomorrow.

You just identified a real structural difference between English and Punjabi that any good translation has to account for. Tomorrow we'll put this into practice, translating real sentences from English to Punjabi.

objectives: Learn the words ਵਾਕ (sentence), ਸ਼ਬਦ (word), ਕ੍ਰਮ (order)
Identify the Subject-Verb-Object (English) vs. Subject-Object-Verb (Punjabi) word order difference
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Introduce today's 3 new vocabulary words.
2. Explain the SVO (English) vs. SOV (Punjabi) word order difference using the water example.
3. Have the child identify the SVO structure of 'The girl reads a book' and predict its SOV rearrangement.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's topic: translating real sentences.
differentiationTips: Struggling: use physical word cards (or written words on paper) the child can physically rearrange from SVO to SOV order
Ready for more: ask them to find one more English sentence and identify its SVO structure independently
All Gurmukhi words used in this lesson were validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਵਾਕ = sentence. 2. ਸ਼ਬਦ = word. 3. ਕ੍ਰਮ = order. 4. English typically follows Subject-Verb-Object order; Punjabi typically follows Subject-Object-Verb order.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Introduces the course's 'translation practice' description with the foundational structural concept (word order difference) needed before attempting real sentence translation.
